rule: A quest is a step counter advanced by server triggers (Interact, WhisperReceive keyword, EnterArea with a radius, GiveItem to a named target) with actions (GiveQuest, IncQuestStep, Talk, FinishQuest). Each quest has a level window, so an early quest closes by level (City of Camelot is level 1 only). Rewards are XP on accept and finish, a basic item or one optional item, and a money share. Starter gear is chosen by class id with class 0 meaning all. Each service is introduced by visiting it through the Camelot Assistant's six-place destination menu.
keep: Three-beat opener: walk into a ring, one whisper word, tap the instructor
Level window as a deadline (a level-1 quest closes at level 2)
One-verb journal line per step with bracketed keywords
Six-place service menu through one NPC, one service per trip
One-word whisper lesson (combat style words) before a one-of-six choice
Class-chosen starter set announced by a centre-screen message
change: Ten-step City of Camelot chain with NPC waits: use three to five steps in our first 30 minutes
PC verbs (left-click, right-click) become tap verbs on a 375 wide screen
Typed whisper keyword becomes a tap chip
NPC wait steps are finished by the server, not by the player asking again
Replace every donor name and place name (GPL, clean-room)
look_test: Build a 375-wide mock with four beats: a ring walk that changes the journal line; one tap-chip replacing the whisper; a six-pin service sheet opening one pin per errand; a reward card with the class-chosen starter set and a centre-screen line. Compare whether Dom finds the next tap within 10 seconds and whether the journal stays at two lines.
